fields: [pic=2]Hey. man! Good to see you here!
[pic=2]Hey! If it isn’t our stand-in barber!
[pic=3]We heard you treated Finley quite well.
[pic=2]We might have you as an apprentice!
[pic=3]Y’know, Rascal also gave me a special treatment afterward…
[pic=2]Yeah, apparently Rascal here appreciated my assets, and wanted to have a go back there.
[pic=2]Haha ok ok, my ego can only get so inflated!
[pic=3]Anywho, he hopped on back and showed me what Red Pandas can do!
[pic=2]I had no idea they had knots!
[pic=6]Yeah… I’m not sure that they do…
[pic=3]He’s kinda big for his size huh? Don’t suppose it caused ya too much trouble though Finley?
[pic=4]Well I haven’t been practicing much these days - and there was no time for warming up.
[pic=3]I see! Sounds like we gotta toy around with you more often then.
[pic=2]Yeah, occasionally Finley’ll let us pin him down and stuff some toys up there!
[pic=2]Yeah, when was the last time we even fooled around?
[pic=4]Mmm. It was when we were gonna paint together.
[pic=5]I had to run an errand so I was a bit late.
[pic=3]When I got there, I saw Claire’s got her muzzle more than half way down your shaft.
[pic=3]OOOH right! Dang, that was some time ago!
[pic=2]I keep telling Finley, I’m gonna deep throat him one day.
[pic=3]So I’ll give it a shot every so often. He’s a good sport for being so willing.
[pic=2]Who am I, to shatter the dreams of an ambitious lady.
[pic=3]Gosh, I still remember that pull out. That was QUITE the load Finley.
[pic=3]Yeah that was my fault. We were at it for a WHILE and I didn’t want him getting soft on me.
[pic=4]Honestly props to him for lasting so long.
[pic=3]Y’know the rest of that night was pretty hot too…
Wait, but I didn’t hear anything about toys.
[pic=3]Like I said, we’re overdue for a session!
Hit me up when that happens!
